---

*This is the last homework of the semester --- thank you for your work throughout the course.*

*Please answer honestly and in your own words. Do not use AI to generate your responses. There are no right or wrong answers here. I am genuinely interested in your experience, and your feedback will directly inform how I develop this course in the future.*

*This should not take more than 30 minutes — you have enough on your plate right now. Short and honest beats long and polished.*

---

**1.** What clicked for you in this course, and when did it click?

**2.** What did not click, and what do you think would have helped?

**3.** Which week or topic was hardest for you, and why?

**4.** What would you keep as is, and what would you change about the course?

**5.** Do you think you are likely to use any of what you learned beyond this course? If so, in what context?

**6.** Is there anything else you want me to know?
